label: Batam
short_description: The Riau Islands city off Singapore, from Nagoya downtown to the Harbour Bay waterfront and private islands.
intro: Batam's hotels in this directory sit across the Riau Islands city a short ferry from Singapore: the Nagoya commercial downtown, the Harbour Bay waterfront near the ferry terminals, and a private-island resort in the surrounding archipelago. The mix serves both weekend leisure and business travellers, reached via Hang Nadim International Airport (BTH) or the ferry terminals from Singapore and Johor.
